direction5.identity: F=(1+M)/2 with M=P20-P02: Z is a functional of the odd polynomial M alone; the even sector never enters
direction5.counterexample: L=3, P11 -> (3/2) P11 with P20, P02 fixed: same M (hence same odd content, M(1/2) unchanged), different F, different Z
direction5.verdict: the odd sector M governs Z; the even sector P11 is invisible to Z but visible to the pair — so no functional of the pair beyond its odd projection can be recovered from Z (W4's 'governs' direction dies; the converse — Z does not determine the pair — is exact)
